text: Stakeholder/RACI owner and approver are named. Scope includes in scope and out of scope. Assumption and constraint are listed. Change Request and change control are defined. UAT acceptance sign-off maps to RTM traceability from BRQ to FR to US to TC. Handover includes KT and warranty.
The project has scope and stakeholders. The team will implement features and discuss changes later.

Problem and persona are defined with user pain point. MVP scope and release roadmap are listed. Backlog contains user story and acceptance criteria with prioritization. Success metric KPI and analytics event tracking funnel are defined. Hypothesis experiment and risk assumptions are listed.

Regulatory compliance includes KYC AML. Payment transaction settlement and reconciliation are specified. Security authentication authorization and fraud controls are included. Audit log evidence is retained. NFR availability latency SLA performance are defined. Exception rollback timeout retry handling is documented. UAT traceability RTM acceptance is required.
